page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn8v-4x.8xlarge is a GPU-accelerated virtual machine instance built on the KVM hypervisor. It features 32 dedicated vCPUs powered by an Intel Xeon 8469C processor running at a base frequency of 2.6 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The instance is equipped with 384.0 GB of system memory, providing a high memory-to-core ratio of 12.0 GB per vCPU.

Acceleration is delivered via four onboard GPUs with a combined VRAM capacity of 384 GB. This instance does not include local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met through network-attached options. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 20 Gbps, and the instance does not include any complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Given the density of its hardware profile, which pairs dedicated Intel Xeon processing cores with substantial GPU resources and system memory, this instance represents a high-resource tier. The lack of local storage requires external storage provisioning, which should be factored into architectural planning. It is designed for workloads requiring parallel processing capabilities and large memory footprints, such as deep learning training, large-scale AI inference, data science pipelines, and complex graphics rendering.
